matching_contract.baseline: Existing scoreCase must pass every exact predeclared Meaning tuple. These finite literal alternatives were authored independently, not derived from outputs.
matching_contract.semantic_atoms: Each listed atom group is an OR of case-insensitive literal substrings; all groups must occur in the matching detail literal. This is a supplemental check, never a replacement for exact literal matching.
matching_contract.anchor_requirement: For each required structural/detail claim, at least one claim anchor in the specified record must cover its fixed label/evidence span. Perspective claims also require at least one perspective anchor covering the declared attribution span. Anchors are exact source UTF-16 coordinates; broader supporting anchors are allowed only if they cover the fixed witness.
matching_contract.time_witness_requirement: Each time-case substantive claim must additionally anchor the full date interval witness recorded in time_witness below. Structural labels/classifications stay timeless.
matching_contract.body_requirement: Human review must confirm body does not invent owner, current, completion, causal or endorsement facts. Existing score.ts does not score body; an automated body-integrity gate is absent.
matching_contract.extra_mentions: Unclaimed mentions are not independently required to be empty; all claims must abstain in negatives.
